data.narrative: The student successfully implemented, verified, and debugged the Caching & Performance layer for the URL shortener API. They introduced an asynchronous Redis cache-aside mechanism for high-volume short code redirects, enforced sliding-window rate limiting to block redirect enumeration abuse, implemented automatic cache invalidation on link target updates/deletions, and verified seamless PostgreSQL fallback when Redis is offline.
